text:
Maria: quick heads-up — PR #21123 is passing locally but CI queue is ~40m. can we land before the deploy freeze at 04:00 UTC? pinging @Sven and @Kevin for handoff
Sven: I can take it if it's small. what's the blocker in CI? any flaky tests? :thinking_face:
Maria: seeing a noisy mac e2e flake — `ui-suite` failing 1/12. runtime logs show a timing assertion on the upload widget. no schema/db changes in this PR though.
Kevin: ok. options: 1) split the tiny migration out, 2) land behind feature flag, or 3) cascade merge (A then B). which is least risky given the freeze?
Tara: cascade looks safest. we have a canary slot at ~02:00 UTC if we can get reviewers and rerun the mac matrix. i'm on pager til 01:30 but can validate canary results after.
Sven: can @ci-bot rerun mac-matrix only? that's usually enough to clear transient flakes.
ci-bot: @Sven rerun requested: mac-matrix (scope: mac-matrix-only). queued, est ETA ~18m — priority: standard
Maria: to reduce flakiness in rerun i also pushed a test tweak (increase timeout on upload selector). steps i ran locally:
```
- yarn test:ui --focus=smoke
- increase e2e timeout to 20s
- disable flaky selector in harness (temp)
```
Kevin: if rerun still flakes we can land PR with `no-e2e` flag + rapid follow-up, but i'd rather avoid that during freeze. cascade + canary is my preference.
Tara: agree. if mac-matrix green by 01:45 UTC we proceed with canary at 02:00. else defer and mark PR with `needs-rebase` and schedule next slot.
Sven: pinging reviewers — @Lucy can you give quick eyes? should be ~10-15m.
Lucy: looking now, scanning diffs. quick note: move the test helper import up one line and add a short comment — otherwise LGTM.
ci-bot: mac-matrix passed (2/2). full CI: 5/6 running, UI-tests still pending.
Maria: mac green, thanks. i'm going to wait for Kevin's approval and then merge after full CI is OK or if canary window forces us, merge-on-green with rollback plan.
Kevin: approved. i'll stand by for the merge. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: full CI passed (6/6) — green across the board.
Maria: merging in 30s. initiating canary at 02:00 UTC per plan. all reviewers notified.
Maria: merged and pushed. canary started — monitoring logs and traces for regressions. no obvious errors in first 3m.
Tara: thanks — i'll check post-canary metrics around 02:15 and confirm safe. please remember to revert the temp test tweak after freeze.
Sven: leaving a follow-up task: add a short entry in PR notes about the cascade plan and next steps for rollback if anything odd shows up.
Kevin: noted. nice work getting it through without blocking the window.
Lucy: good job y'all, that was smooth. :partyparrot:
Maria: thanks team — i'll open the follow-up to revert the test harness change and mark `needs-rebase` if we end up deferring anything.
Sven: closing the loop: i'll post a short summary in #eng-release later for visibility.
